name: project-pm
description: One PM session per project: a live board of every Claude Code session (waiting on you, stopped mid-plan, CI still running) and a ledger of the work you asked for, so nothing slips.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the board, the PM instructions and the tools: auto follows the system (any Chinese locale reads Traditional Chinese), en, or zh-TW. /pm lang sets it too.
